_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Clive is comparing Irish market offers…

description: Benchmarks Irish household bills, financial products, and subscriptions across Broadband, Electricity, Natural Gas, Dual-Fuel Energy, Mobile SIM-Only, High-Yield Savings Accounts (incl. 33% Irish DIRT net yield math), Insurance, and Streaming — calculating monthly/annual EUR savings, Top Pick rationale, switching checklist, and rendering Clive’s interactive comparison widget.

currentAerPct.description: For category="savings": current gross AER % earned on the user’s cash (default 0.25%).

currentMonthlySpend.description: Optional user’s current monthly spend in EUR (e.g. from analyze_bank_csv) to calculate exact euro savings.

currentProvider.description: Optional user’s current provider (e.g. "Virgin Media", "Electric Ireland", "AIB") so Clive prioritises new-customer switchers.

depositBalanceEur.description: For category="savings": deposit balance in EUR to model gross & post-DIRT interest (default €10,000).

preferences.description: Optional preferences such as "no contract", "EV night boost", "1Gb SIRO", "instant access", "Vodafone network".

query.description: What to compare (e.g. "1Gb fibre broadband", "electricity EV night rate", "SIM-only 5G", "instant access savings for €15,000", "home insurance", "streaming overlap").
